exceptions.rationale: Informational unmaintained-only advisory for a build-time proc macro used directly by tokenizers 0.22.2; paste is not linked into or callable by the release binary, has no normal dependencies, and contains no unsafe blocks. macro_rules_attribute was upgraded to 0.2.3 to replace its independent paste edge with pastey. Re-evaluated 2026-08-09: the current fastembed 5.17.2 lock and published fastembed 5.17.4 both require tokenizers 0.22.2, while published tokenizers 0.23.1 still requires paste. No published maintained dependency path removes the residual without replacing or forking the embedding stack. Re-evaluate the upstream tokenizers migration before expiry.

The advisory requires LruCache::pop to unwind while dropping a key with a panicking Drop implementation. The only release-closure use is Tantivy 0.26.1's document-store cache, which instantiates LruCache<usize, OwnedBytes>, calls get/put/len but not pop, and uses usize keys that have no Drop implementation. Upstream Tantivy merged its lru 0.18.2 bump in quickwit-oss/tantivy#3034 on 2026-08-06, but has not published a release containing it. Re-evaluate and remove this exception as soon as that Tantivy release is available.
